why: The txs the MintSwap team calls the hack are Yoink's own (index 0 of blocks 19563164/65); the pool's full transfer history shows Yoink's tx is the first sell-path call ever, so there is no attacker tx to beat or replay. The only third-party tx it pre-empted is an innocent user's pending 5,991 vMINT sell (public mempool 9.4 s earlier, reverted afterwards), which Yoink's different-shaped call does not replay; whether it triggered the bot is unproven. A second searcher made two small sells (0.78 ETH) only after Yoink.
strength: no other exploiter before Yoink (complete pool transfer history); pending user sell is a possible but unproven trigger; Yoink txs are private, so absence from the mempool archive is expected
